notes: Structured summary of the public CVPR review form. Not a verbatim copy of the reviewer guidelines.

subdimensions.label: Technical quality
subdimensions.guidance: Correctness of the method, appropriateness of the benchmarks and strength of the ablations.

subdimensions.label: Novelty
subdimensions.guidance: Originality relative to the closest vision work, including new tasks, representations or analyses.

subdimensions.label: Clarity
subdimensions.guidance: Clarity of the method, figures and experimental protocol; reproducibility of the reported results.

deskRejectRules: The submission violates the page limit or the dual-submission policy.
The submission is not anonymized when required.
The submission is not a research paper or cannot be parsed.

template.summary: Summarize the visual task, method, datasets and main results.
template.strengths: List concrete strengths with figure, table or section references.
template.weaknesses: List concrete weaknesses with figure, table or section references.
template.questions: Ask questions that could change the rating after rebuttal.
template.limitations: Discuss limitations of the method, datasets, metrics and claims.

rubric.summary: Check that the summary covers the actual visual task and evaluation, not only the architecture.
rubric.technical: Check dataset splits, metric choices, baseline strength and ablation coverage.
rubric.novelty: Reward new tasks and analyses, not only a new module stacked on an existing backbone.
rubric.clarity: Check that figures and tables are legible and that the evaluation protocol is specified.
rubric.deskReject: Desk rejection is a format, anonymity, scope or integrity decision.
